headline: Rehearsal schedule on the home page
text: The next rehearsal shows its date, time, place, and the tracks to practice. Tap a track to play it.
caption: The home page with the next rehearsal: date, time, place, and the tracks to practice. Tapping a track plays it.

headline: Track list and player
text: Playback continues while you move between pages. Save a set to play it offline.
caption: A set's track list, with the player bar at the bottom of the screen.

headline: Full-screen player
text: Cover art, a waveform you can scrub, and repeat.
caption: The full-screen player: cover art, waveform scrubbing, and repeat.

headline: Schedule rehearsals in the admin
text: Each rehearsal is a post. Set the date, time, and place, add a note, and pick the tracks.
caption: Editing a rehearsal in the admin: date and time, place, note, and the tracks to practice.
